messages:
ben_s: Quick sync — Acme POC kickoff. They want a drop-in bridge so their existing calls to RivalAPI -> Redwood with zero prompt changes if possible. Timeline: 2-week POC. Can we confirm scope and roles? @maria_se @tess_eng

maria_se: Scope I'd propose: adapter (translate headers + response shape), prompt mapping doc, sample test suite (5000 prompts), perf targets (95th < 150ms hosted), security questionnaire answers. Presales will handle pricing.

jamal_pm: Pricing ask from customer: compare Hosted vs Dedicated for 100 requests/sec avg, 5k tokens/request. They want committed price for first 6 months. Ben, can you prepare ballpark numbers?

ben_s: Ballpark: Hosted: $0.0009/token generation + $0.0006/token input => rough math: ~ $6k/day at 100rps * 5k tokens avg. Dedicated: starting at $XXk/month for reserved pool (lower unit cost). I'll DM exact tiers.

tess_eng: Tokenization delta: RivalAPI uses slightly different BPE vocab. We'll normalize by pre-tokenizing in the proxy and adjust max_tokens.
Example request mapping:
```
curl -X POST https://redwood.internal/bridge \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "x-rival-api-key: <token>" \
  -d '{"prompt":"...","max_tokens":1024}'
```
We also need to remap response shape: Rival's "choices" -> map to "outputs" and preserve "finish_reason".

ops-bot: deploy-bot: staging-bridge v0.1 deployed :white_check_mark:

jamal_pm: Eval plan: run 5k prompt set across translation, QA for semantic parity. Metrics: embedding cosine > 0.92 on 1k QA pairs; token delta < 2% avg; hallucination increase < 1%.

tess_eng: Also capture prompt context window diffs. Rival allowed 4k; our chosen model 8k but tokenization can reduce effective space. Add a failing test if response truncates unexpectedly.

ciso_ellen: Security Qs: confirm KMS (AWS KMS + HSM option), EU data residency option, SCIM + SSO support, audit log retention 1 year. Need egress IPs list for allowlist.

maria_se: I'll attach answers and a KMS diagram. cc: @ciso_ellen. POC kickoff: https://calendar.example.com/meet?eid=abc123 — Wed 10AM PT.

ben_s: Risk: model behavior shift -> paraphrase deltas. Propose side-by-side diff on first 200 requests and manual review. If divergence >5% fallback to Rival-compatible alias.

tess_eng: Canary plan: 5% traffic for 48h. Rollback if error rate >1% or avg latency >250ms or semantic divergence >7%.
Canary command:
```
kubectl -n prod set image deploy/bridge bridge=bridge:v0.1-canary
```

jamal_pm: Ownership: Maria + Tess -> prompt mapping doc. Ben -> pricing write-up. Jamal -> coordinate legal sign-off and data retention.

ciso_ellen: Add contract clause: logs retention window, encryption-at-rest, metadata scrub policy. I'll send a template.

maria_se: Thanks team — uploading POC checklist to ops folder and will ping link here. :thumbsup:
